name: Random Game Picker
summary: Settings app plus a direct Play Random Game shortcut using saved filters.

notes: Stable 0.4.0 adds Play Random Game.sh and --play-random: read existing state/settings.json, select once with saved system/favorites filters, revalidate and submit one ES launch without SDL initialization or picker UI. Missing/malformed settings, unavailable saved systems, empty pools, stale or ambiguous games, failed saves and ES failures block safely; no fallback or launch retry is added. The original Random Game Picker app retains settings, optional saved YOLO and normal preview/Play/reroll/back behavior. The direct shortcut works independently of YOLO and preserves its saved value. Host/race and SDL fixtures cover both target sizes; 0.4.0 remains UNTESTED on hardware. The owner's 0.2.2 and 0.2.0 reports remain historical exact-version evidence. Store review status remains experimental.

The version-specific URL, exact size and SHA-256 pin the reviewed bytes. GitHub reports immutable=false: this is not a server-enforced immutable release. The Store rejects replacement bytes; release.immutable declares the pinned-content contract, not a GitHub repository setting.

The picker reads effective ES system configuration, gamelists and the live ES catalogue; no game ROM directory or emulator command is hardcoded. Tools and Emulators are identified by exact system IDs; only path-only candidates use the confirmed /userdata/roms/tools and /userdata/roms/emulators roots. Ports, collections, missing/hidden games and ambiguous launch paths remain excluded. Application systems still contribute to launch-path ambiguity checks.

The only network use is bounded HTTP to 127.0.0.1:1234. Play closes SDL, sends one exact raw-path POST to ES and exits. HTTP acceptance does not confirm play; there is no retry or nested configgen fallback.

The Store manages its package directory and two independent Ports menu entries: Random Game Picker and Play Random Game. Preserve the entire state directory: settings.json, atomic settings.json.tmp, replaced-per-run last-run.log and ui.log. The system string and favorites boolean are unchanged; an absent yolo boolean defaults off, so old settings need no migration. Published-byte fresh Install, legacy 0.3.0-to-0.4.0 Update, damaged-file/deleted-menu Repair and Uninstall fixtures at both target sizes preserve nested state and the saved YOLO setting. Shared or user-edited entries remain unowned. A nonstandard configured Ports root needs manual installation in that root instead. Use the matching new Store binary and signed catalogue; old Store binaries reject additional_menus.

Includes the TSP-tested A/B and X/Y correction: default KNULLI SDL bindings translate back to ES labels. The launcher honors the Ports Xbox-layout flag, which keeps the identity mapping. Both launcher and binary must update together; this report does not verify every external controller or MagicX.

Published AArch64 ELF inspection establishes a glibc 2.34 minimum. Firmware SDL2, SDL2_image, SDL2_ttf and SDL2_gfx are required; no firmware library is bundled or replaced. Go/module/font license notices replace the old C++ runtime notices; no libstdc++ runtime dependency remains.

evidence.note: Owner reconfirmed all current apps working and tested on TSP. Uses the previously confirmed Knulli AArch64 1280x720 TSP matrix; separate lifecycle results were not supplied.
Owner confirmed all seven current versions tested on TrimUI Smart Pro only. Separate lifecycle steps were not reported.

Downloaded stable ZIP: 3,279,887 compressed bytes, 7,877,205 regular-file bytes across 21 files; SHA-256 8a91b69cc89f2d3acd8300f3294384db78c1ef47757c671e2eba2a968cbe392b. Publisher artifact.json and SHA256SUMS.txt agree. Flat layout; no archive links, state or bundled libraries. All six anonymous public downloads match GitHub sizes and digests. GitHub does not enforce immutability for this release.

MIT project license. ZIP includes THIRD_PARTY.md, Go toolchain and module LICENSE/COPYING files, and the DejaVu font notice. SDL libraries remain firmware dependencies. Historical C++ notices in THIRD_PARTY.md describe 0.1.1, not the Go executable.

ELF64 AArch64, interpreter /lib/ld-linux-aarch64.so.1; highest GLIBC symbol 2.34. NEEDED: libSDL2_image-2.0.so.0, libSDL2-2.0.so.0, libSDL2_ttf-2.0.so.0, libSDL2_gfx-1.0.so.0 and libc.so.6. No libstdc++ runtime dependency.

Launcher sets package-local state and reads /var/run/ports_xbox_layout.flag without writing it. Settings/atomic temporary file, last-run.log and ui.log stay under state. ES config, ROMs, art and saves are read-only to the picker; the launched emulator can make its normal writes. Only bounded loopback ES requests are used.

Passed gated 0.4.0 release workflow builds in Debian 12 and publishes the ARM64 ZIP, artifact.json, SHA256SUMS.txt, abi.txt, archive-inventory.txt and build-info.txt without rebuilding after device checks. Release bytes and metadata were independently downloaded and checked. Host/race includes 44 real-binary headless cases; SDL fixtures at both sizes cover UI-save/direct-launch/UI, YOLO on/off persistence and recovery, normal preview/reroll/cancel/Play, demo isolation and existing exclusion/controller regressions. No physical-device pass is claimed.

Go development-build TSP evidence: firmware gfx/startup, 161-game selection, 100 injected rerolls, default/Xbox effective mappings, exact-path Gambatte handoff and ES restoration. RA login errors prevent normal gameplay/hotkey-return proof. Physical presses and audible audio remain unverified. This does not grant stable 0.2.0 or MagicX a verified badge.

install.warning: Experimental Go 0.4.0; UNTESTED on hardware. Play Random Game reads saved settings and submits one launch without picker UI. Open Random Game Picker first to configure/save filters; it retains optional YOLO and normal controls. Missing/invalid settings, unavailable systems, stale games and failed saves block the shortcut. Tools and Emulators remain excluded. Requires glibc 2.34+, firmware SDL2/image/ttf/gfx and local ES API. No launch retry; inspect state/last-run.log and state/ui.log before retrying. Standard Ports location only. Settings/logs stay after uninstall.
